title: Claude Code Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for .claude-plugin/plugin.json — the manifest file that defines a Claude Code plugin's metadata and component configuration.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema file.

name.description: Unique plugin identifier in kebab-case (no spaces).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in UI surfaces. Falls back to name when omitted.

defaultEnabled.description: Whether the plugin starts enabled when the user has not set a preference. Defaults to true.

version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). If omitted, the git commit SHA is used instead.

description.description: Brief explanation of the plugin's purpose.

commands.description: Flat .md skill files or directories (replaces default commands/).

agents.description: Agent markdown files or directories (replaces default agents/).

hooks.description: Hook config paths or inline hook configuration.

mcpServers.description: MCP server config paths or inline MCP server configuration.

lspServers.description: LSP server config paths or inline LSP server configuration.

outputStyles.description: Output style files or directories (replaces default output-styles/).

themes.description: Color theme files or directories (replaces default themes/).

monitors.description: Background monitor config paths (replaces default monitors/monitors.json). Deprecated in favour of experimental.monitors.

experimental.description: Components whose schema may change between releases.

themes.description: Color theme files or directories (replaces default themes/).

monitors.description: Background monitor config paths (replaces default monitors/monitors.json).

userConfig.description: User-configurable values prompted at enable time.

server.description: Must match a key in the plugin's mcpServers.

dependencies.description: Other plugins this plugin requires, optionally with semver version constraints.

title.description: Label shown in the configuration dialog.

description.description: Help text shown beneath the field.

sensitive.description: If true, masks input and stores in secure storage.

required.description: If true, validation fails when the field is empty.

default.description: Value used when the user provides nothing.

multiple.description: For string type, allow an array of strings.
